I found four call sites in `openmrs-module-webservices.rest` that call `OrderSetService.saveOrderSet`: three in production code and one in a test. I did not open the files. These line numbers come straight from a grep for `saveOrderSet`, so I haven't checked the surrounding methods.

**Production code**
- `OrderSetResource1_12.java`, line 71. This is the REST resource's save path for order sets. It returns the result of `saveOrderSet` directly.
- `OrderSetMemberResource1_12.java`, lines 154, 166 and 174. These three calls save the parent order set when order set members are created, updated or deleted. A change to `saveOrderSet` would affect all of them.

**Test code**
- `OrderSetMemberController1_12Test.java`, line 85. It calls `saveOrderSet` to set up a test order set. It would only be affected indirectly.
